column1: # The places of the map of nx-gir (nxgir_map.py): the
# ancient Armenian names only, in the spelling of the
# books. One line per place, fields split by tabs:
#   id    Latin letters and dashes; a post names it
#   kind  city, fortress, monastery, region, lake or
#   lat   degrees north, as on a modern map
#   x, y  where its pin stands on the painted map, in
#         percent of its width and height; empty: the
#         place is projected from lat and lon
#         (CONTROL in nxgir_map.py). The map is art,
#         so a pin may stand on the painted tower or
#   note  the modern name and what we are unsure of;
# The area of the map: 36.5-42.5 N, 38.0-49.5 E (the
# Armenian Highland). Cilicia is outside it.
# Coordinates are given to about 0.1 degree.
